title: Stale quotes still count toward a prop consensus and the "N books" figure
steps: Run evidence/PCFB-002.pipeline.ts, case 5b: fresh DK quote, three other books 60-90 min old (stale threshold 10)
expected: Quotes past the stale threshold should not build fair price or count as books (a graded prop needs >=2 fresh books).
actual: consensus uses all byBook quotes regardless of age: row shows "books 4", consP 0.6006 built from 3 hour-old prices, +8.11% edge on the fresh DK quote and it lands in feed.keep (grade none only because of the consensus-only cap; a 2-5% case would be graded B on a consensus of old prices). Only the best book age is checked.
suspected_area: priceMarkets: filter `full` by age before consensus / books count
